summary: Enhance your skills with our Advanced Data Analysis and Dashboard Reporting Training Course. Learn to create impactful reports and make data-driven decisions.
lede: Advanced data analysis turns structured data into validated findings and decision-ready dashboards. For data analysts, business analysts, BI developers and reporting managers, the work includes profiling data, validating SQL extracts, modelling measures and defining KPIs. Learners also practise dashboard design, statistical interpretation and executive insight writing, with attention to data quality, governance and validation of AI-assisted summaries.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with structured data and need to produce more reliable analysis, interactive dashboards, and executive reporting. It suits learners with intermediate analytical experience who want deeper practice in modelling, validation, visual communication, and technology-enabled reporting workflows.
modules: Data Analysis Foundations and Decision Framing
SQL Analysis and Reproducible Data Preparation
Power BI and Tableau Dashboard Design
prerequisites: You should have intermediate experience working with spreadsheets, structured datasets, or recurring management reports. Familiarity with basic SQL, descriptive statistics, and at least one reporting or visualization tool will help you gain full value. No programming qualification is required, and coding is not mandatory for completion. Python pandas, DAX, and Tableau calculations receive operational application rather than production engineering depth. A laptop is recommended for practical exercises. Tool access can use Power BI Desktop, Tableau where available, SQL practice software, and Python with pandas.
